propositions: Bedrock inference-profile ids must be invokable in account 896586841071/us-east-1 before corpus spend; temperature capability differences are explicit via supports_temperature override.

The two-arm paired run verifies payload parity (system prompt, messages, tools byte-identical across providers), tool parity (6 tools with identical schemas), and provider-clean routing (zero non-Bedrock calls on v2 arm).

The corpus pools 30 gold-labeled cases across 15 eval specs, excluding agentic disposable-store reviewers; per-pass model mapping is held equal (sonnet/opus pairing), making provider the only variable.
Errored ItemRecords are excluded from parity flip scoring; temperature rejections on opus are caught by the pre-existing supports_temperature mechanism and do not count as sampling-parameter errors.

The recorded live run at 3 epochs per arm shows Bedrock structurally equivalent on payload and tools; decision-level flips are out of scope because they compare different models' judgements, not provider behavior.
